source: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Cost of Cultivation Studies & Punjab Agriculture Department Advisories
reference_notes: Baseline estimates for Punjab Kharif: Transplanting manual labour averages Rs 3800-4200/acre; DSR seed drill rental with tractor Rs 1200/acre; Laser land levelling amortised cost Rs 1000/acre; AWD reduces tubewell pumping hours by 20-30% saving 6-7 irrigations; Punjab Govt direct incentive for DSR is Rs 1500/acre (via portal); MSP for common/Grade A paddy is Rs 2300-2320/quintal.
